---
description: "Use when editing project, operation, learning, or validation documentation."
applyTo: "docs/**,README.md,CONTRIBUTING.md"
---

Separate authored, statically reviewed, compiled, tested, and measured status.
Never fabricate screenshots, benchmarks, passing results, or physical validation.
Commands are human instructions for the named target, not authoring permission.
Keep units, frames, names, paths, state transitions, metadata blockers, and
recording limitations consistent with source. Planned webcam work stays planned.
